description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class named CountryTest, which tests the Country entity within the OrangeHRM project. The class includes setup procedures and a test method to verify the properties and persistence of a Country entity object.

classes.name: CountryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Country entity within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating the Country table to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testCountryEntity
methods.description: Creates a new Country object, sets its properties, persists it, retrieves it from the repository, and asserts that the properties are correctly stored and retrieved.
